verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no self-serve audience export (for example, a CSV or other open-format download of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list). Only developer building blocks appear: paginated API list endpoints, a custom-field list endpoint, and webhooks for unsubscribe and bounce events. A developer could use these to construct an export, but under the partial-credit rules they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
